summary: The root شحح (shHH) primarily describes being intensely covetous, stingy, or avaricious.

headwords.gloss: He is niggardly, tenacious; with me, of such a thing; syn. with

parts.t: with me, of such a thing
There shall be no acting in a niggardly manner, of one with another, in the making of peace, one with another
Such a one is tenacious of such a one;

headwords.def: هُوَ يُشَاحُّنِى بِكَذَا [ He is niggardly, tenacious, &c., as above, with me, of such a thing ]. (A.) [The inf. n.] مُشَاحَّةٌ [in the CK erroneously written مَشاحَّة ] is syn. with ضِنَّةٌ : (K, TA:) hence the saying, لَا مُشَاحَّةَ فِى الاِصْطِلَاحِ [ There shall be no acting in a niggardly manner, of one with another, in the making of peace, one with another ]. (TA.) And one says, فُلَانٌ يُشَاحُّ عَلَى فُلَانٍ Such a one is tenacious of such a one; syn. يَضَنُّ بِهِ . (S, L.)

headwords.gloss: The people; party, were niggardly, tenacious; one to another

parts.t: and vied in hastening to it,
fearing lest it should become unattainable.
affair, each of them being unwilling that it should become beyond his reach,
They straitened each other in pressing to the water, and vied, each with the other, in endeavouring to satisfy their thirst

headwords.def: تشاحّ القَوْمُ The people, or party, were niggardly, tenacious, &c., as above, [see 1,] one to another, (Msb, K, TA,) فِى الأَمْرِ [ in the affair ], (K, TA,) and عَلَيْهِ [ for it ], (TA,) and vied in hastening to it, (TA,) fearing lest it should become unattainable. (K, TA.) And تَشَاحَّا عَلَى الأَمْرِ لَا يُرِيدَانِ أَنْ يَفُوتَهُمَا (S, O, K, TA) They two (i. e. two men, S, O) contended together for the thing, or affair, each of them being unwilling that it should become beyond his reach, or attainment. (TA.) And تَشَاحَحَا المَآءَ [or تَشَاحَّاهُ ] i. q. تَجَاشَعَاهُ [i. e. They straitened each other in pressing to the water, and vied, each with the other, in endeavouring to satisfy their thirst ]. (TA in art. جشع .)
